violations.description: Hardcoded secret keys and default admin password in app/app.py
violations.evidence:
app/app.py:26: app.config['SECRET_KEY_HMAC'] = '...'
app/app.py:27: app.config['SECRET_KEY_HMAC_2'] = '...'
app/app.py:28: app.secret_key = '...'
app/app.py:63: user.password = '...'
violations.recommendation: Read secret keys and passwords from environment variables rather than hardcoding them in source code.

violations.description: Insecure use of yaml.load without SafeLoader allowing arbitrary code execution
violations.recommendation: Use yaml.safe_load(y) instead of yaml.load(y) to prevent arbitrary code execution vulnerabilities.

violations.description: Third-party GitHub Action referenced by mutable branch (master) instead of pinned tag or SHA
violations.recommendation: Pin the action to a specific release tag or commit SHA (e.g. jakejarvis/wait-action@v0.1.1 or SHA).

violations.description: No linting or formatting tool configured in the repository
violations.evidence: No linter or formatter configuration (pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, .flake8, ruff.toml, .pre-commit-config.yaml) or CI lint step exists.
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter/formatter such as ruff, flake8, or black and integrate it into development and CI workflows.
